title: About DocKosha
subtitle: DocKosha is an open-source document sharing and virtual data room application, with access controls, watermarking, and privacy-first analytics.

whatWeDo.title: Secure Document Management for Professionals
paragraphs: DocKosha is built for M&A teams and founders running deal, investor, and diligence rooms. It also supports lawyers and fundraising teams sharing confidential packets with tighter controls than generic file links.
We focus on high-fidelity viewing and practical controls: watermarking, link permissions, and privacy-first analytics designed to minimize unnecessary data collection.

Our application source is public under AGPL-3.0-or-later for inspection and contribution. DocKosha Cloud is available today. Independent self-hosting is not yet available because DocYantra, our document-processing engine, remains a private dependency.
